quotes.speaker: Brandin Podziemski
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandin Podziemski explains the 'winning the elbow' training concept
quotes.excerpt: I have a really good chance of getting that shot off.
quotes.quote: One of the guys, you know Brandin, his trainer, he has a phrase that he uses and he always calls it winning the elbow. So what he means is, like the way he looks at it as a defender, if I can get my elbow here before you have your chance to get your hands up, I have a really good chance of getting that shot off. I have just taken that and thought about that in terms of using the momentum of the bounce to get us to our spots quicker.
